source: Author's runs of 2026-10-10 (EP-0211, EP-0215). Values copied from the episodes and from the audit repository kryptos-k4-audit: ep0211-bifid-deletion-residue-20261010/ (record.md, count.log, k4.json, k4.log, null.log, plants.log, regress.log, dstar1.log; commits 366eb3c registration, eb98b83 controls, 87bc100 null, ba6c581 K4, 2d65b53 record) and ep0215-enigma-sigma-crib-gap-20261010/ (record.md, prereg.md, count.log, report_k4.log, report.log, plants_*.log; commits df3cdd1 registration, 2240ca4 controls, 41c8ddc K4, aee02b4 null and record). Statistics only.

EP-0211 one-square Bifid with a deletion.model: Bifid with ONE free 5x5 square (exact), W removed (92 letters). Between the cribs (carved 33..59 in the 92 coordinates) d cipher letters were lost after enciphering (d = +1, +2) or d junk letters were carved (d = -1, -2); two letters = two adjacent letters (registered approximation). Blocks: periods 2-12 with every first-block offset a0, the whole text as one block, or W segments (period p or one block per segment). Edge column: two-letter squares (free Four-square, keyword Four-square / Two-square) with d = +-2 next to a crib edge (after crib 1, before crib 2, or both) and pairing phase 0 or 1.
EP-0211 one-square Bifid with a deletion.preregistration: rules, N, E gate, stop rule, controls and the two negative columns committed before K4 (366eb3c); the edge column was registered as forced by EP-0110

null_before_K4.rule: a column is applied to K4 only if E (share of shuffles with a consistent setting) <= 0.05

posthoc_outside_the_rules.screen: d* <= 1 on the main column (d* = fewest crib positions to drop to make a structure consistent)

main.logical_refutation: closed (0/2,649 structures, undetermined 0; with the 5,797 settings equivalent to EP-0169)
main.rarer_than_random: not claimed (all 200 shuffles are inconsistent too)

edge.logical_refutation: closed, but implied by EP-0110 (crib-internal pairs alone contradict every pairing) and fixed before the run

remaining_undecidable: square + mask (the mask index shifts with d)
97-letter Bifid with W as a letter

EP-0215 Enigma + sigma with a machine-st.model: C_i = E_s(i)(sigma(P_i)) with sigma a free substitution and E_s a reflector machine (no plugboard); s(i) = i on crib 1 and i + d on crib 2, d in {-2, -1, +1, +2}; for d < 0 the machine is not stepped back, crib 2 at i uses state i - |d|. Entry wheel read three ways: identity, QW, QWi. h = fewest crib positions to drop so that a consistent sigma exists (with sigma free, one altered crib letter costs one position).

R1-1.machines: Enigma I, rotors I-V (3 of 5) x reflectors A, B, C = 30 machines (EP-0193 T2)

EP-0215 Enigma + sigma with a machine-st.settings_per_column_formula: machines x 6 rotor orders x 26^3 ring offsets x 26 reflector positions x 26^2 turnover phases

chance_per_setting.formula: union bound over drop sets D with |D| <= h of (26)_k / 26^m (m = remaining crib positions, k = distinct crib letters among them; values uniform on 26 letters), EP-0192 T3

E_R1-1_h_le_2_not_registered.note: closed form over the 12 Enigma I columns; the record and the registration say 0.4, which is the value for two entry readings, not three

EP-0215 Enigma + sigma with a machine-st.allocation_reason: the unadjusted plan (R2-6 h<=2 at all four d) gave E 0.0635 > 0.05; R2-6 keeps h<=2 at d = +-1 (the size of both precedents) and drops to h<=1 at d = +-2, which adds 1.3e-4 to E instead of removing d = +-2

controls.plants_detail: d != 0 x 3 readings x 2 exact (h = 0) 24/24; x 2 crib-altered (h <= letters altered) 24/24; d = 0 x 3 readings equal to the original kernel's hit sets 3/3
controls.regression_d0: LB histograms and exact h counts identical to EP-0209 (both families, QW and QWi)
controls.unit_tests: GPU values and lower bounds == the original simulator (all d, 3 readings); exact h == scipy (6,000) == brute force (400)

null.shuffle: W-keeping permutation of the other letters (seed 215000 + s); d = 0 columns skipped

R1-1.columns: QW reading x d != 0 only (16 pooled column values, correlated within a shuffle)

R1-1.logical_refutation: closed: entry identity/QW/QWi, d in {-2,-1,+1,+2}, up to 1 altered crib letter
R1-1.rarer_than_random: cannot say (E 0.033; 0 passes happens about 97% of the time by chance)

R2-6.logical_refutation: closed: entry identity/QW/QWi, up to 2 altered letters at d = +-1 and 1 at d = +-2

remaining_undecidable: a shift together with errors inside crib 1
